source_name: Zhiyong Sun, Shiyu Zhao and Daniel Zelazo, “Characterizing bearing equivalence in directed graphs”, arXiv:2303.05576 (2023).
statement: Let $L_{\text{B}}$ be the bearing Laplacian of a directed formation. **Zhao's conjecture.** Every eigenvalue of $L_{\text{B}}$ has nonnegative real part. This conjecture concerns the spectrum of the generally asymmetric bearing Laplacian for directed graphs containing cycles; its resolution is not specified in the supplied source context.
title: Zhao's nonnegative-real-part conjecture for directed bearing Laplacians
